name: cn-social/search
description: Search recent posts and articles across Chinese news sites, Weibo, WeChat, Zhihu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili and Kuaishou by keyword, with source and time-range filters. Results come from a cached index, so rare keywords can return few items.

end.description: End time of the search period (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). Required for initial request.

start.description: Start time of the search period (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). Required for initial request.

source.description: Target social media platform for search filtering.

keyword.description: Search query string. Supports these five syntax forms: - AND (&&): A && B matches content containing both A and B. - OR (||): A || B matches content containing A or B. - Exclusion (-): -A matches content that does not contain A. - Parentheses (): (A && B) || C matches content containing C, or both A and B. - English double quotes (""): "A" disables tokenization and requires an exact match for A.

nextCursor.description: Pagination cursor provided by the 'nextCursor' field in the previous response.

readme: # China Social Media Search API Returns a list of recent posts and articles that match a keyword across Chinese news sites and social platforms such as Weibo, WeChat, Zhihu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili and Kuaishou. It needs a `keyword` and a time range set by `start` and `end`. You can limit results to one platform with `source`. ## Use cases - Track how often a topic such as 人工智能 appears in Chinese news and social posts over a two-week window. - Collect WeChat official account articles that mention a brand or product name. - Build a news feed for one keyword by combining `title`, `url` and `sourceName`. - Exclude noisy terms with the `-` syntax to monitor a narrow topic. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/cn-social/search" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "人工智能", "source": "ALL", "start": "2026-10-19 00:00:00", "end": "2026-11-02 00:00:00"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `end` | string | No | End time of the search period (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). Required for initial request. | | `keyword` | string | No | Search query string. Supports these five syntax forms: - AND (&&): A && B matches content containing both A and B. - OR (//): A // B matches content containing A or B. - Exclusion (-): -A matches content that does not co | | `nextCursor` | string | No | Pagination cursor provided by the 'nextCursor' field in the previous response. | | `source` | string | No | Target social media platform for search filtering. | | `start` | string | No | Start time of the search period (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). Required for initial request. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "list": [ { "author": { "avatar": "http://wx.qlogo.cn/mmhead/0nn3FBrD9a32s1WibMMeS0gAAyXicFNonzp9kicxpmfqYF5q7ODcrp…", "id": "gh_e3feebbd6659", "nickname": "阳城文学编辑部", "username": "gh_e3feebbd6659" }, "content": "` and `` tags, and long bodies may be cut. | | `list[].image[] / list[].video[]` | Lists of image and video URLs attached to the item. An item without media can return an empty list, or a list holding one empty string. | | `list[].author.nickname / list[].author.username` | Display name and account name of the author. Both are empty strings for some news items. | | `list[].author.id / list[].author.avatar` | Author account ID and avatar image URL. Both can be empty strings. | | `nextCursor` | Cursor string for the next page of results. | | `totalNumber` | Total number of items that match the query. | ## Notes - To get the next page, send the `nextCursor` value from the response as the `nextCursor` parameter, with the same `keyword`, `source`, `start` and `end`. - Write `start` and `end` as `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. They are required on the first request. - `source` accepts `ALL`, `NEWS`, `WEIBO`, `WEIXIN`, `ZHIHU`, `DOUYIN`, `XIAOHONGSHU`, `BILIBILI` and `KUAISHOU`. The default is `ALL`. - `keyword` supports `&&` for AND, `||` for OR, `-` for exclusion, parentheses for grouping, and English double quotes for an exact match. ## Pricing $0.028571 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
